get.summary: Get Adjustment and Adjustment Line Items of a Project
get.description: Get Adjustment and Adjustment Line Items of a Project. Each page will have a maximum of 100 items.

parameters.name: budget_change_id
parameters.description: Restrict results to adjustment line items belonging to this budget change. Pass the budget_change_id returned on each line item to fetch only that budget change's adjustments.

parameters.name: adjustment_id
parameters.description: Restrict results to line items within this specific adjustment. Use together with budget_change_id to narrow to a single adjustment group.

Link.description: Link headers for applicable first, prev, next, and last page links

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items available to be retrieved

data.description: Array of Budget Change Adjustment Line Items

items.description: Budget Change Adjustment line item Summarized

id.description: ID of the line item. ID can be combined with the type to uniquely identify an adjustment line item for a project

adjustment_number.description: The number of the adjustment this line item belongs to

wbs_code_id.description: Identifier of the WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) code this line item is allocated to. Null when the line item is not yet assigned to a budget code.

amount.description: Currency amount of this adjustment line item. Null when no amount has been set.

uom.description: Unit of measure for this line item's quantity (e.g. 'ea'). Null when the line item is not quantity-based.

quantity.description: Quantity for this line item, expressed in the unit given by uom. Null when the line item is not quantity-based.

description.description: Free-text description of this adjustment line item. Null when no description was provided.

type.description: Used to identify type of line item. Type can be combined with the ID to uniquely identify an adjustment line item for a project. Type change_event corresponds to the first line in an adjustment in the UI. The subsequent lines of that adjustment are of type budget_change

budget_change_number.description: The number of the budget change this line item belongs to

budget_change_status.description: The status of the budget change

budget_change_name.description: The name of the budget change

budget_change_id.description: The ID of the budget change

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/budget_changes/adjustment_line_items?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&budget_change_id=1&adjustment_id=5")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
